To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

bug tracking systems can be improved by (a) providing a better user interface for bug reporting, (b) allowing reporters to provide more relevant information, (c) providing a mechanism for identifying files that need to fixed and (d) allowing reporters and developers to communicate in a more natural way.

bug reports are often incomplete and bug tracking systems are to blame for this; we can enhance bug tracking systems to help developers gather relevant and complete information about bugs; we can enhance the process of fixing bugs by automatically identifying relevant files that need to change to fix bugs.

bug tracking systems can be enhanced by (1) using a combination of natural language and structured information, (2) providing a mechanism to capture and reuse information, (3) allowing users to interact with the bug tracking systems, and (4) using the information provided to identify the files that need to get fixed.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (a) How can we improve the bug reporting process to make it more effective? (b) What information do developers need to fix bugs? (c) Can we design bug tracking systems that help users report bugs effectively? and (d) Can we design systems that help developers fix bugs more effectively?
improving bug tracking systems by making them more user-friendly, interactive, and efficient.
making bug tracking systems more effective by improving communication between developers and users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed system would help improve the quality of bug reports and thus help resolve bugs faster.

we propose to improve bug tracking systems in four broad directions: 1) by providing a better interface to enter bug reports; 2) by providing better tools to analyze bug reports; 3) by improving the communication between reporters and developers; and 4) by improving the tools to fix the bugs.

the proposed bug tracking system can improve the efficiency of the bug fixing process by reducing the number of interactions between developers and reporters, and by providing the developer with a list of relevant files that need to fixed to resolve the reported bug.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bug reporting process is a two way street and the bug tracking system should be designed to help users report bugs in an efficient and effective way.
our prototype is a step towards making bug tracking systems more efficient and effective.
we have proposed a set of guidelines to improve bug reporting and have demonstrated a proof-of-concepts prototype that implements some of these guidelines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a well-designed bug tracking system can help improve the efficiency of bug resolution process and thus reduce time-to-fix.
a well-designed bug reporting system can help developers resolve issues faster.
the design of bug tracking systems can be significantly improved to reduce the time and effort spent on bug resolution by both developers and reporters.
